gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-gidole: Nulshock stretches out wide with spacious tracking and a steady, unshaded outline, like a technical label. And Gidole follows in plain sans, its open terminals and high midline keeping the text lighter than the heading above.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-golos-text: Stretched and bold, Nulshock lays down a technical outline heading over Golos Text, whose tall x-height fills each line of body copy. Text settles into an approachable, steady texture.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Technical in spirit, Nulshock looks like ink poured at one width, stretched wide and bold across the top. Hedvig Letters Sans does the opposite job, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals and a clear gap where the c ends.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-heebo: Heebo brings a tall central band of text with curves that stop short. Under Nulshock's wide, single-thickness outline, a modest body size would let the heading's spacious tracking take the lead.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-guntur: Modern in feel, Hind Guntur is the quieter half, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and tall lowercase forms. Nulshock's stretched, outlined capitals contrast with it, and long paragraphs in this sans-serif would read smoothly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-madurai: Nulshock is stretched and technical, its unshaded outline running wide with spacious tracking. Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly like capitals, and its s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-mysuru: Wide, bold and outlined, Nulshock makes a technical statement with barely any gap between its capitals and lowercase. Hind Mysuru answers in sans with tall lowercase and open-mouthed a shapes, so the text sits quietly beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-siliguri: Nulshock stretches its spacious tracking across the line, drawing a bold, technical outline with no shading anywhere in it. Hind Siliguri hums along with constant line weight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-vadodara: Professional in tone, Hind Vadodara keeps its stroke thickness constant, with tall bowls and spacious gaps in its round letters, beneath the wide technical outline of Nulshock. Paragraphs run smoothly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-huninn: Nulshock's wide, spacious tracking and steady unshaded outline give it a bold, technical stamp. Huninn supports it with s terminals kept clear of the body and lowercase rising close to cap height, so the text feels modern beside it.
